name: How much does it cost to build a guest home in San Diego County?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build a guest home in San Diego County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to build a guest home varies significantly based on factors like size, design complexity, chosen materials, site preparation requirements, and utility connections. A basic detached studio guest home might start around $150,000, while a larger, more custom two-bedroom unit could exceed $300,000. These figures include design, permits, and construction, but specific site conditions and luxury finishes can increase the overall investment. It's best to get a detailed quote tailored to your property and specific vision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for a guest home in San Diego County typically range from $150,000 to over $300,000, depending on size, design, materials, and site-specific conditions. A custom quote provides the most accurate estimate.
